PAVAN KALYAN BODDU RPA Developer | Power Platform Consultant | AI & Automation Specialist Email: pavankalyanboddu8919@gmail.com | Mobile: +91 8919867201 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pavankalyanboddu

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Automation Developer with 4.5 years of experience delivering workflow automation, low-code applications, and RPA solutions using Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop), Power Apps, AI Builder, Copilot Studio and Blueprism. Strong expertise in building AI-driven Copilot Agents, agentic automations, scalable enterprise workflows, and integrating business systems to enhance operational efficiency.

SKILLS & TECHNOLOGIES

Automation: Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop), Blue Prism - Power Platform: Canvas Apps, Model-Driven Apps, Dataverse, SharePoint - AI & Copilot Automation: AI Builder, Copilot Agents, Agentic Flows - Data & Reporting: Excel automation, Power BI dashboards - Tools & Cloud: SAP, Jira, ServiceNow, Microsoft Visio, Microsoft Azure, AWS (Admin) - Soft Skills: Problem Solving, Communication, Team Leadership, Process Optimization CERTIFICATIONS

Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-500) - Blue Prism Developer Certification: AD01 - AWS certified cloud practitioner

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

HSBC – Assistant Manager | RPA & Power Platform (2023 – Present)

Built end-to-end automation workflows using Power Automate, reducing manual tasks by 40%. - Designed AI Builder models to automate document processing with 95% data accuracy. - Developed Power Apps to streamline approvals and reduce process time by 30%. - Designed and developed Commercial Banking Assistant for underwriters using Copilot. - Created Power BI dashboards to monitor bot utilization and improve exception handling. - Improved workflow reliability with structured logging and error handling.

TCS, System Engineer – RPA Blue Prim and Power Platform (2021 – 2023) - Designed and developed Blue Prism workflows with browser-based applications. - Handled bot maintenance, upgrades (v6.10.5), and IE to Edge migration. - Provided L2 level support, incident resolution, and process improvements. - Managed exception handling and continuous improvement for bot performance. - Created process documentation and supported UAT and deployments.

PROJECT HIGHLIGHTS

Hyper Automation Solution – Power Apps + AI Builder + Power Automate:

Developed a canvas Power App for users to upload various types of KYC documents. - Built and integrated a document segregation AI Builder model triggered via Power Automate Cloud Flows. This

model classifies document types and routes them to appropriate AI Builder models trained on credit cards, passports, employment contracts, pay slips, and more.

The extracted data is stored in a CSV file, processed, and passed back to Power Apps for review and validation. - Created supporting Power Automate Desktop flows that access third-party applications like Omiga, TransUnion, and BMM to fetch customer verification data. This involved a maintenance module that resets application credentials, a loader to queue volumes, and a worker module to collect and store outputs in a formatted MI report.

Output reports are distributed to business users for validation and decision-making.

Incident Management Tracker - Built a Power App integrated with SharePoint to manage incident reports for RPA bots. - The app captures details such as ticket ID, description, status, assigned team member, and comments. - Notifications are sent via Outlook to inform users about ticket updates, enabling efficient tracking and resolution

of issues.

Automated Birthday Email Workflow - Designed a Power Automate scheduled workflow that reads employee data from a SharePoint list to check for

birthdays.

Automatically sends a personalized birthday greeting email to employees using Outlook integration.

Leave Approval Cloud Flow - Automated leave approval using SharePoint triggers. - - Updated request status after approval/rejection and sent confirmation notifications to employees.

Implemented manager approval logic with automated reminder emails for pending actions.

Automated Banking Applications – Power Automate Desktop (Migration) - Migrated Blue Prism bots to Power Automate Desktop to interact with web-based banking systems. - Automated data retrieval from Omiga, TransUnion, and HUB applications. - Data was formatted and consolidated into master Excel files for monthly reporting, saving the business 20 FTEs.

Commercial Banking Assistant (Copilot Agent) - Designed and implemented an intelligent Commercial Banking Assistant that responds to the underwriter queries

with provided knowledge sources. It provides information on financial analysis, Risk management, Credit Structuring with useful documentation and training links.

Migration and Version Upgrade Projects – Blue Prism - Upgraded Blue Prism from v6.10.3 to v6.10.5, enabling enhanced features and improved stability. - Migrated bots from Internet Explorer to Microsoft Edge due to deprecation, solving multiple UI spying

challenges.

Upgraded SAP from v750 to v770, re-spied SAP elements, aligned the layouts and configuration settings.

Blue Prism Bot Operations & Support - Performed routine bot health checks, handled production issues, resolved exceptions, and implemented change

requests in line with SLAs.

Documented technical workflows using Microsoft Visio for audit and knowledge transfer.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering MVGR College, Vizianagaram – Andhra Pradesh | Graduated 2020

INTERESTS

Learning new automation tools Building useful apps Continuous Learning
